title.narrative: She Leads Africa Regional

description.narrative: SUMMARY The Plan International Pan-Africa office advocates for policies and fair practices that reflect, respond to, promote and protect children's righs in Africa and equality for girls. The office engages with civil society (CSO) and key African human rights bodies such as several deperatments and division of the African Union, ACERWC, ACHPR, Regional Economic Communities (RECs) to strenghten and protect girls' rights accross Africa, with focus on the She Leads implementing countries. The Plan International Pan-Africa office will link the She Leads partners and GYW-led organisations with the African regional fora and support the She Leads country partners in their regional and international lobby and advocacy.

comment.narrative: The Pan African programme focuses on the Africa Regional agreements and policies to influence. This could be trough Pan African institutions such as the African Union, ACHPR, ACERWC, African Conference of Ministers of Gender & Women Affairs, AU Department of Gender, AU Office of the Youth Envoy and the RECs(EAC and ECOWAS), will adopt concrete measures to increase meaningful participation of GYW and improve member states' accountability towards GYW rights. The target is: 6 policies , 1 strategy. Maputo protocol, ACHPR, CRC, CEDAW, ACRWC, IGAD Youth Policy Strategy of protection of GYW on digital space.
The Pan Africa network influenced various country level processes and regional fora for greater GYW participation
